title: Why Parallel Universes Are Probably Real
summary: Veritasium explains the many-worlds interpretation of quantum mechanics, drawing heavily on Sean Carroll's book. It walks through the Schrodinger equation and why wave collapse may be unnecessary if the universe keeps splitting.
why: Recommended as an accessible explanation of many-worlds versus single-world wave collapse.

quote.text: Veritasium has a great video that explains the concept of parallel worlds vs wave collapse in a single world
